title: SM ST2C
text: 离散时间或连续时间同步电机 ST2C 静态励磁系统，带自动电压调节器，输入 10 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} 指定初始输出电压、{Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电压、{Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)} 指定初始机端电流、{Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} 指定补偿电阻、{Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} 指定补偿电抗、{Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Voltage regulator proportional gain, K_PR (pu)} 调节器比例增益、{Voltage regulator integral gain, K_IR (pu/s)} 调节器积分增益、{Maximum voltage regulator output, V_PImax (pu)} 指定 PI 控制的调节器输出上限、{Minimum voltage regulator output, V_PImin (pu)} 指定 PI 控制的调节器输出下限、{Voltage regulator gain, K_A (pu)} 调节器增益、{Voltage regulator time constant, T_A (s)} 调节器时间常数、{Rate feedback gain, K_F (pu)} 指定速率反馈增益、{Rate feedback time constant, T_F (s)} 指定速率反馈时间常数、{Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)} 调节器输出上限、{Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)} 调节器输出下限、{Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} 指定 OEL 输入位置、{Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} 指定 UEL 输入位置、{Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} 指定 SCL 输入位置、{Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)} 指定整流器负载系数、{Exciter field proportional constant, K_E (pu)} 指定励磁机磁场增益、{Exciter field time constant, T_E (s)} 指定励磁机磁场时间常数、{Maximum generator field voltage, E_FDmax (pu)} 指定发电机励磁电压上限、{Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} 指定电势电路电压增益系数、{Compound circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} 指定电势电路电流增益系数、{Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)} 指定电势源电抗、{Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)} 指定电势电路相位角、{Maximum available exciter voltage, V_Bmax (pu)} 指定励磁机电压上限，按实例取值。
